2610.06751.title: MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion
2610.06751.paper_summary: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.
2610.06751.paper_summary_zh: 矩陣補全是從表格插補到因果推斷的問題基礎，但現有的表格基礎模型將其視為逐項預測，對每個目標重複上下文並忽略了矩陣的二維結構。我們介紹了MatrixFormer，一種預訓練的矩陣原生Transformer，它在單次前向傳播中為每個缺失條目預測完整的分佈。MatrixFormer 完全在多樣的缺失模式下對合成低秩和潛在因子矩陣進行訓練。在零樣本應用中，使用相同的模型權重，MatrixFormer 在因果推斷面板數據任務、語言模型基準分數補全、表格插補和推薦系統矩陣補全上達到了競爭性能。這些結果使MatrixFormer成為一個通用的矩陣補全基礎模型。
